info.title: Music Nerd API: users and profile
info.description: The signed-in user's own account and profile page: their user name, profile photo, approved claim, contributed artists, contribution summary and the updates feed. Moved from MusicNerdWeb's `/api/user/*` and `/api/profile/*` routes (xdjs/MusicNerdWeb#1454). Every route answers about the caller only; the account comes from the token, never from the request.

get.description: The caller's own user row, with the same camelCase fields Music Nerd's site reads (`usernameNeedsConfirmation` and `usernamePromptedAt` drive the user-name prompt). `id` must be the caller's own id: anyone else, admins included, gets 403, exactly as the Web route did.

403.description: `id` is not the caller's own id.

example.error: Forbidden

404.description: No user row for that id (a stale session after an account merge).

example.error: User not found

patch.description: Saves a chosen user name for the caller's own account and clears the confirmation flag. Names are reserved case-insensitively (trimmed) under an advisory lock, so two people cannot take the same name; a taken name is 409. An email address or a wallet address is refused. Web returned `status: "success"` with a `message`; the API returns `status: "ok"` with the same `message`, and errors carry `error` instead of `message`.

username.description: The new user name. Trimmed; 1 to 50 characters; no control characters, `@`, or a 0x wallet address.

400.description: The body isn't JSON, or the name is empty, longer than 50 characters, contains control characters, or is an email or wallet address.

value.error: User name must be 50 characters or less.
Choose a user name instead of an email or wallet address.

403.description: `id` is not the caller's own id.

example.error: Forbidden

409.description: Another account already has that name (compared trimmed and case-insensitively).

example.error: That user name is already taken. Try another.

post.description: Marks that the caller has been shown the one-time prompt to choose a user name, and says whether to show it now. `showPrompt` is true only the first time, and only while the generated name still needs confirmation; every later call returns false.

showPrompt.description: True when this call recorded the prompt for the first time.

403.description: `id` is not the caller's own id.

example.error: Forbidden

503.description: The database could not be reached.

example.error: Could not load your user name setup.

get.description: Whether the caller has an approved artist claim, and which artist. Always 200: without a valid token, or when the database cannot be read, it answers `hasClaim: false` rather than an error, exactly as the Web route did, so the navigation never breaks on it.

200.description: The caller's approved claim, if any.

none.summary: No claim, no token, or the database is unavailable

get.description: A one-hour signed URL for the caller's profile photo in Supabase Storage, or `url: null` when none has been uploaded. The optional `X-Profile-Account` header lets the page detect that the signed-in account changed underneath it.

200.description: The photo URL, or null. `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

url.description: A signed URL valid for an hour, with a cache-busting `v` query, or null.

401.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, or no user row for it.

409.description: `X-Profile-Account` was sent and is not the caller's id.

example.error: Your account changed. Refresh and try again.
Could not load your profile photo

post.description: Replaces the caller's profile photo. Accepts a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB, re-encodes it as a 512×512 WebP with orientation applied and metadata stripped, and stores it under the caller's own folder. The Web route also required the browser's `Origin` to match the site; the API authenticates with a bearer token rather than a cookie, so that check is not needed here and is not ported.

file.description: A JPG, PNG or WebP image, at most 2 MB.

400.description: No `file`, an empty file, the wrong type, over 2 MB, or an image the decoder rejected.

badFile.summary: Missing, empty, wrong type or too large

value.error: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image smaller than 2 MB
This image could not be read. Try another JPG, PNG or WebP.

401.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, or no user row for it.

example.error: Not signed in

409.description: `X-Profile-Account` was sent and is not the caller's id.

example.error: Your account changed. Refresh and try again.

413.description: The request body is larger than 2 MB plus form overhead.

example.error: Choose an image smaller than 2 MB
Could not save your profile photo. Try again.

get.description: The About text for up to six artists, for the bookmarks strip on the profile page. An artist's `bio` is returned only when the artist has an approved claim and the About is real (not the claim nudge); otherwise it is null. Web returned a bare array; the API wraps it as `summaries` so the response can carry `status`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An artist id (a UUID). Repeat for up to six artists; duplicates are collapsed.

200.description: One row per requested artist. `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

bio.description: The About, or null for an unclaimed artist or one without a real About.

summaries.bio: Bio Ritmo is a 10-piece salsa band from Richmond, Virginia.

400.description: No `id`, more than six, or one that isn't a UUID.

example.error: Provide up to six artist IDs

get.description: The artists the caller has contributed to (added, had a link accepted on, or edited as the claimant), 24 per page in name order, with an optional name search. `imageUrl` is the stored portrait when it is a local path or a credential-free HTTPS URL, else null.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts. Up to six digits; defaults to 0.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A case-insensitive name search, up to 200 characters.

200.description: A page of artists. `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

next.description: The `offset` for the next page, or null on the last page.

400.description: `offset` isn't one to six digits, or `q` is longer than 200 characters.

example.error: Invalid artist search

503.description: The database could not be read.

example.error: Could not load your artists

get.description: The counts on the profile page (link submissions, approved and pending, artists added, claimant edits) and the caller's three most recent link submissions.

totalContributions.description: All link submissions by the caller.

selfEdits.description: Edits made as an artist's claimant.

artistsAdded.description: Artists the caller added to Music Nerd.

entries.description: The three most recent link submissions.

503.description: The database could not be read.

example.error: Could not load your contributions. Try again.

get.description: The latest cards from the caller's artists, six artists per page in the same order as [Your artists](/api-reference/users/profile-artists), up to two cards per artist, newest first. Built from the stored [artist Latest](/api-reference/artists/latest): releases, Instagram posts, In Process moments and published interview answers. `checked` is how many artists have been read so far; `next` is the `offset` for the next six. Web also fetched Spotify, Deezer and In Process live when a snapshot was missing and attached source links to interview cards; the API serves its stored snapshots as they are, so a missing snapshot is reported in `unavailableProviders` and interview cards carry no source link.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The artist to start from, in the caller's artist order. Up to six digits; defaults to 0.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Which cards to keep. `All`, `Release`, `Socials` (Instagram posts and In Process moments) or `Lore` (interview answers); `Instagram`, `Interview` and `In-Process` are older filter names that still work.

200.description: A page of cards. `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

checked.description: How many of the caller's artists have been read, this page included.

next.description: The `offset` for the next page, or null once every artist has been read.

unavailable.description: True when at least one artist's Latest could not be fully read.

unavailableProviders.description: Which providers were failed or missing, sorted; null when a read failed for an unknown reason.

400.description: `offset` isn't one to six digits, or `kind` isn't a known filter.

503.description: The caller's artists could not be read.

example.error: Could not load artist updates

privyBearer.description: The signed-in user's access token. Copy it at https://musicnerd.net/access after signing in. Every route here answers about that user only.

ProfileAccountRequired.name: X-Profile-Account
ProfileAccountRequired.description: The user id the page believes is signed in. Must equal the token's user, or the response is 409 so the page can refresh instead of showing another account's data.

ProfileAccountOptional.name: X-Profile-Account
ProfileAccountOptional.description: The user id the page believes is signed in. When sent, it must equal the token's user, or the response is 409.

NotSignedIn.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, or no Music Nerd user for it.

example.error: Not signed in

AccountChanged.description: `X-Profile-Account` is missing or is not the caller's id.

example.error: Account changed. Refresh and try again.

InternalError.description: The database could not be read or written.

example.error: Internal server error

User.description: The caller's user row, as stored.

usernameNeedsConfirmation.description: True while the name is a generated one the user has not confirmed or replaced.

usernamePromptedAt.description: When the one-time user-name prompt was shown, or null.

imageUrl.description: A local path or credential-free HTTPS URL, or null.
The artist's stored portrait, as stored.

ProfileUpdate.description: A stored Latest card (see the artist Latest endpoint) with the artist it belongs to. `id` is prefixed with the artist id so cards from different artists never collide.
